components.css: .sample-detail{color:var(--ink,#131d20);background:var(--paper,#f0eee7);font:16px/1.6 Archivo,Arial,sans-serif;border-top:1px solid var(--paper-line,#cccfc7);border-bottom:1px solid var(--paper-line,#cccfc7)}.sample-detail summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding:24px 0;list-style:none;cursor:pointer}.sample-detail summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.sample-detail summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #876029;outline-offset:6px}.sample-detail summary svg{transition:transform 200ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1))}.sample-detail[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.sample-detail p{margin:0;padding:0 0 24px;max-width:68ch;color:#45564f}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.sample-detail summary:hover{color:#876029}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sample-detail summary svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: Real work leads through large typography and authentic product imagery. Dark portfolio sections contrast with light reading surfaces, while native disclosures let visitors inspect contribution and evidence at their own pace. English and Arabic remain complete static pages.
keyCharacteristics: Dark editorial sections and light reading surfaces

rules.name: Surface rule
rules.body: Use whole-section ground changes to distinguish reading modes, rather than arbitrary colored cards.

rules.name: Content rule
rules.body: Keep title, role, date, evidence, and body copy visually distinct.

dos: Do preserve real imagery and explicit evidence scope.
Do keep content available without JavaScript.
Do preserve keyboard focus, RTL composition, and reduced motion.
Do use 16px mobile search-input text to avoid iOS zoom.
donts: Don’t imply private company source is public.
Don’t add repeated scroll reveals or hover-only actions.
